name: WildLife
description: WildLife is a defunct Detroit street clique, active approximately 2012–2013, with documented rivalries with Bandcrew, TSN, RTM, CMH, and HoodRich. The group appears in disrespect callouts from Southside Blocc Gangsta Crip-affiliated sets, suggesting a Blood or independent affiliation. The clique is no longer active.

sources.title: Historical and Defunct Street Groups in Detroit – DetroitStreetGangs.com
